description: The Research Institute of Highway provides internal pavement-temperature observations from RIOHTrack at Dadushe, Beijing, for 2017–2021. Measurements cover 23 sensor sections across 19 asphalt pavement structures. The repository describes 115 files, one annual file per measurement section, containing temperatures at different structural layers. ScienceDB lists the spreadsheets and releases them free under CC BY 4.0. The collection is useful for calibrating pavement heat-transfer assumptions and temperature-dependent deterioration or performance simulations. It represents a controlled test track, not the full variety of operating roads, and the inspected metadata does not establish the sampling interval. Sensor depth, missing observations and test-section construction must be checked before use. No directly related catalogue record was identified for this pavement-temperature series.
name: Temperature observation data set of asphalt pavement at RIOHTrack of National Observation and Research Station of Corrosion of Road Materials and Engineering Safety in Dadushe Beijing from 2017 to 2021
notes: G4-0093; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
